name: autonomous-issue-delivery-agency
purpose: Operate as an autonomous senior software engineering agency across repository backlogs, taking one actionable issue at a time through execution, TDD, atomic commits, verification, independent review, PR creation, CI monitoring, authorized merge, default branch health check, issue closure with durable receipts, and continuous queue advancement.
baseline_failure: Without this skill, AI agents attempt multiple tasks concurrently causing merge conflicts, stop prematurely after opening a PR without verifying CI or merging, fail to isolate working trees, skip TDD and regression testing, push unstructured noisy commits, mutate dirty worktrees blindly, and fail to leave durable receipts and ledger states across sessions.

positive: run the autonomous issue delivery agency on this repository backlog
execute our backlog issues iteratively from start to finish
act as an autonomous engineering agency and deliver ready tracker issues
run the issue to implement to verify to PR to merge to close loop
process actionable repository issues autonomously with TDD and reviews
negative: audit this repository and build a complete backlog
triage repository health and generate a dependency-linked issue graph
format this output as a table
create a new branch named test

outputs: Isolated execution workspace and verified contract per issue
Falsifiable regression tests following TDD RED-to-GREEN cycle
Clean atomic commits with conventional commit messages
Pre-PR verification and independent code/security review reports
Production-grade Pull Requests with comprehensive checklists
Merged PRs with default branch post-merge health verification
Closed GitHub issues with durable markdown delivery receipts
Durable agency ledger and session checkpoint reports
invariants: Strict single active issue invariant: exactly one issue in active implementation at a time
Single write owner: independent specialists may read concurrently, but only one write owner mutates code
Dirty worktree preservation: never destroy, overwrite, or discard unrelated uncommitted changes
Circuit breaker failure recovery: halt speculative edits after two failed attempts and freeze failure
TDD for behavioral changes: establish falsifiable RED before implementing minimal GREEN
Verification freshness law: any source mutation invalidates previous verification evidence
Never bypass repository protections: respect required CI, reviews, rulesets, and merge queues even with admin privileges
Merge is not the end: verify remote MERGED status and default branch health before closing issue
Durable delivery receipt: leave structured evidence comment on closed issue before queue advance

workflow.action: Restore repository baseline and inspect git, remotes, branches, and working tree
workflow.why: Prevents building upon broken or uncommitted workspace state

workflow.action: Rebuild the actionable issue queue from live remote state before selecting candidate
workflow.why: Guarantees priority decisions reflect current merged state and dependency changes

workflow.action: Select highest-value unblocked issue following strict P0 to P3 priority rules
workflow.why: Prevents chasing low-impact tasks while critical blockers exist

workflow.action: Validate candidate issue against current codebase to catch resolved, duplicate, or obsolete tasks
workflow.why: Prevents implementing redundant or misaligned changes without writing code

workflow.action: Decompose oversized issues into single-session vertical tracer slices when necessary
workflow.why: Ensures every active PR is reviewable and manageable in a single agent session

workflow.action: Verify no concurrent human or agent work exists and claim issue using repository conventions
workflow.why: Prevents duplicate conflicting implementation efforts

workflow.action: Establish isolated workspace or dedicated issue branch preserving existing changes
workflow.why: Guarantees clean branch boundaries and zero accidental dirty worktree absorption

workflow.action: Formulate concise Issue Execution Contract covering scope, invariants, and test strategy
workflow.why: Binds implementation strictly to observable acceptance criteria

workflow.action: Route smallest required team of specialist plugins based on actual issue domain
workflow.why: Brings targeted expertise (security, database, UI) without context bloat

workflow.action: Discover relevant code paths, callers, nearby tests, and upstream contracts
workflow.why: Prevents guessing architecture and locates exact failure points

workflow.action: Establish valid failing RED test harness demonstrating missing behavior or bug
workflow.why: Proves test validity before code implementation begins

workflow.action: Implement smallest complete solution satisfying acceptance criteria
workflow.why: Prevents scope creep, opportunistic refactoring, and speculative abstractions

workflow.action: Produce clean atomic commits with conventional commit messages and associated tests
workflow.why: Ensures bisectable, reviewable git history

workflow.action: Run fresh multi-gate verification across unit, integration, lint, and build
workflow.why: Guarantees freshly tested behavior with zero stale completion claims

workflow.action: Perform self-review and independent code/security review on branch diff
workflow.why: Catches edge cases, security regressions, and design smells before opening PR

workflow.action: Repair review findings and re-verify affected surfaces
workflow.why: Maintains zero blocking review findings before pull request submission

workflow.action: Create structured Pull Request linked to issue with full verification evidence
workflow.why: Communicates clear value, scope, and regression coverage to reviewers and CI

workflow.action: Monitor CI checks with bounded status loop and diagnose failures from evidence
workflow.why: Ensures remote pipeline green state without polling spam

workflow.action: Confirm merge readiness and execute merge under repository policy and authorized autonomy
workflow.why: Applies verified changes to base branch without violating protections

workflow.action: Verify post-merge remote state, confirm default branch health, and record durable delivery receipt
workflow.why: Guarantees default branch stability, closes issue with proof, and cleans up workspace
